name: Mento Australian Dollar
oneLiner: AUDm is Mento's Australian dollar stablecoin on Celo, issued and retired through the legacy USDm FX Broker pool against the shared Mento Reserve.
collateral: Shared Mento Reserve: current issuer configuration classifies this currency as reserve-backed, not USDm locked in a borrower-specific CDP.
pegMechanism: AUDm is issued and retired through Mento V2's oracle-priced USDm/AUDm Broker/BiPoolManager pool. USDm-to-AUDm swaps burn incoming USDm and mint the FX token; reverse swaps burn the FX token and mint USDm, subject to the configured oracle, spread, trading limits, and breaker checks.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: AUDm remains a legacy Mento V2 shared-reserve token. MGP-18 (August 17, 2026) explicitly lists AUDm and CADm among the FX tokens not yet migrated to CDPs and states that their USDm pools stay live for holder redemption. At Celo block 78972424, the canonical Broker recognizes the BiPoolManager provider and quotes a AUDm-to-USDm swap; verified Broker source burns the input stable asset and mints the output stable asset. The issuer backing configuration independently identifies shared diversified crypto reserve backing. This resolves the operational holder exit model but establishes neither a custodial fiat claim nor borrower-specific CDP. Keep D18 unresolved until a uniform owner-approved shared-reserve mechanism mapping exists; no protective grade is inferred.
